Still stuck. Let me reconsider whether the notice board is really on my tile. The map shows '@' at (2,7) and no 'o' there. The 'o' objects are at (6,6) and (10,5). So the map does NOT show a notice board at (2,7). 

But world_observe insists "Notice Board (notice) at (2,7): blocks". There's a contradiction. Perhaps the notice board is a non-tile object (like a wall-mounted board) that the observe lists at my location but doesn't actually block the tile. In that case, why can't I move?

Wait — maybe the player at (3,7) is blocking me to the right, and the notice board is a red herring. But I can't move up, down, or left either. Let me check: is (2,6) walkable? Map row 6: `#......o....#` — col 2 is '.', walkable. (2,8) row 8: `#.......#...#` col 2 '.', walkable. (1,7) row 7: `#.@P....#...#` col 1 '.', walkable.

So all neighbors are walkable but I can't move. This is bizarre. Let me try a much longer hold.
